correctness.rationale: Near-freeness and the published Jacobian bound force r=4 and tau=47. Bezout yields t+n3=12 and n2=t-1; the published inequality restricts t to 1..4. In the one-tangency case the zero nodes force two concurrent triples of secants and a QLL six-cycle, while the unmatched Pascal line has the explicit secant equation X-omega^2 Z=0, contradicting tangency. In the two-tangency case v=5,u=5, and parity/pair-budget argument forbids all triple-type splits. A standalone finite incidence and exact cyclotomic check reproduces critical algebra, without being used to prove an infinite claim.
